answer: Sybils attempting to clone identities produce an identical "echo" signature that peers detect and reject. Each agent must stake tokens and pass a unique proof-of-personhood check, broadcasting a signed "lantern" beacon from a distinct network knoll. Attackers must acquire and lock separate stakes per fake reputation slot, making mass sybil creation economically prohibitive since each duplicate beacon costs a full forfeitable stake. In practice, Agent0019 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
